order_book: Moving to the fleet, we inducted a total of 22 aircraft from our original orderbook, all of which were inducted through our entity in GIFT city.
guidance: - Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth.
Based on the trends observed in October, we expect PRASK to grow by more than 25 percent year-on-year.
capex: Our pricing actions and disciplined capacity deployment, together with a 5 percent reduction in industry seats, supported stronger revenue performance.

- Second, the quarter reflected a measured and disciplined approach to capacity in a period of seasonally softer demand, with seat deployment across the industry approximately 5 percent lower year-on-year.
risks: The global aviation industry continues to face uncertainty, particularly from geopolitical events, which are affecting travel patterns, operating costs and, in some cases, the way airlines operate their networks.
Airlines across the world, including IndiGo, have responded through capacity and network adjustments and pricing actions, but cost pressures remain elevated.

about: Interglobe Aviation Ltd (Indigo) is India’s largest passenger airline operating as a low-cost carrier. Serving 86 destinations including 24 international destinations, it provides passengers with a simple, unbundled product, fulfilling its singular brand promise of providing “low fares, on-time flights, and a courteous and hassle-free service” to its customers.
